verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a fully self-hosted, open-source inference runtime that runs entirely on the user's own hardware (CPU-first, no GPU required), meaning no data is ever sent to a third-party AI provider for training. Since inference and model execution happen locally, there is no vendor data pipeline through which usage could feed model training. Missing for 10: no explicit written privacy policy/statement disclaiming data collection or training use, and no independent audit confirming no telemetry is phoned home.
